name: @eimg/primer
description: Inspect organizational sources as authorized evidence and cited answers
author: Ei Maung

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:offline:serve: PRIMER_DATA_DIR=.primer/web-offline PRIMER_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=deterministic PRIMER_CHAT_PROVIDER=deterministic PRIMER_DEV=1 tsx watch src/cli.ts serve
scripts.baseline:offline: npm run dev:offline -- init && npm run dev:offline -- sources ingest && npm run dev:offline -- evaluate
scripts.baseline:live: npm run dev:cli -- init && npm run dev:cli -- sources ingest && npm run dev:cli -- evaluate
scripts.baseline:answers:offline: npm run dev:offline -- init && npm run dev:offline -- sources ingest && npm run dev:offline -- evaluate answers
scripts.baseline:answers:live: npm run dev:cli -- init && npm run dev:cli -- sources ingest && npm run dev:cli -- evaluate answers
scripts.readiness:offline: npm run dev:readiness:offline -- init && npm run dev:readiness:offline -- sources register sample-data/acme/sources/markdown --connector markdown-local && npm run dev:readiness:offline -- sources register sample-data/acme/sources/slack --connector slack-export && npm run dev:readiness:offline -- sources sync && npm run dev:readiness:offline -- readiness check --include-answers
scripts.readiness:live:retrieval: npm run dev:readiness:live -- init && npm run dev:readiness:live -- sources register sample-data/acme/sources/markdown --connector markdown-local && npm run dev:readiness:live -- sources register sample-data/acme/sources/slack --connector slack-export && npm run dev:readiness:live -- sources sync && npm run dev:readiness:live -- readiness check
scripts.readiness:live: npm run dev:readiness:live -- init && npm run dev:readiness:live -- sources register sample-data/acme/sources/markdown --connector markdown-local && npm run dev:readiness:live -- sources register sample-data/acme/sources/slack --connector slack-export && npm run dev:readiness:live -- sources sync && npm run dev:readiness:live -- readiness check --include-answers
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
